product_metadata.title: Recipe Card Page Protectors, 50 Count, 4 x 6 inch Pockets, 2 Pockets Per Page, (for 8.5"x 9.5" Binders),by Better Kitchen Products, Recipe Book Pocket Page Refill Sheets, Side Margin Loading,
features: 50-Count clear 4" x 6" recipe card protector sheet/pocket page refills; hold up to 200 recipe cards
8-1/2" x 6-7/8" Sheets with 3-hole punched margins with reinforced edges for added durability; for recipe binders and mini 3-ring binders
Each pocket page holds 3" x 5" or 4" x 6" recipe cards, up to 4 recipe cards with 2 cards inserted back-to-back or 2 double-sided recipe cards
Side-loading at margin for easy card insertion and stay-put security no matter how fast or how often you flip through your recipes
Durable, nonstick, non-glare, archival safe, and acid free sheets provide splatter-proof protection for your prized recipes
